# Attribution

<!-- GENERATED by primal/theme/buildThemes.ts. Do not edit; your changes will be
     overwritten on the next build. Run `buildThemes.ts --check` to verify. -->

15 of the 21 Primal colour themes, from 5 palette families, are generated from palettes in
`primal/design/corpus/`, vendored from the [tinted-theming/schemes]
repository under the MIT licence. `primal/design/corpus/SOURCE.md` records the
exact commit; `primal/design/corpus/LICENSE` is the licence text those palettes
arrive under, copied unmodified.

A Primal theme is not the upstream scheme. Only the palette is taken; the
workbench colours are expanded from it by `primal/theme/tokenMap.ts`, and the
error, warning, diff and conflict colours are synthesised from scratch so that
they are separated by lightness rather than by hue. **No theme ships under an
upstream scheme's name.** Every Primal name below is original to this project.

[tinted-theming/schemes]: https://github.com/tinted-theming/schemes

`Author` is the `author` field the corpus records for that scheme - the person
who contributed the palette to tinted-theming, who is not in every case its
original designer. It is reproduced verbatim rather than researched, because a
generated file must be able to state where every line came from.

| Primal family | Variants | Source scheme | Author | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Primal Umber | Umber Soft, Umber, Umber Hard | Mezcal (`base16/mezcal.yaml`) | Teshre | MIT |
| Primal Pewter | Pewter Soft, Pewter, Pewter Hard | Tomorrow Night Eighties (`base16/tomorrow-night-eighties.yaml`) | Chris Kempson (http://chriskempson.com) | MIT |
| Primal Cinder | Cinder Soft, Cinder, Cinder Hard | Brasa (`base16/brasa.yaml`) | Teshre | MIT |
| Primal Trench | Trench Soft, Trench, Trench Hard | Equilibrium Dark (`base16/equilibrium-dark.yaml`) | Carlo Abelli | MIT |
| Primal Nightshade | Nightshade Soft, Nightshade, Nightshade Hard | Precious Dark Eleven (`base16/precious-dark-eleven.yaml`) | 4lex4 <4lex49@zoho.com> | MIT |

The six original vibes - Ink, Basalt, Tide, Dusk, Fern and Ridge - are
hand-authored for this project and derive from no external palette.
